## Installing

**Already have it?** Nothing to do. Open the program as usual — Windows checks
for a new version each time it starts and updates itself in the background.

**First time on this PC?** Open the `MCAANewsletter.appinstaller` link (the
`AZURE_DOWNLOAD_BASE_URL` variable + `/MCAANewsletter.appinstaller`). Windows
installs the app and, from then on, keeps it up to date.

The packages attached below are the archive copy. **Don't install from them** —
this repo is private, so those URLs need a GitHub login and App Installer has
none, which means an install from here would never receive an update. Publishing
this release is what mirrors the same files to the public URL above; install from
there.

After installing, open **MCAA Newsletter** from the Start menu. The first launch
asks which folder the newsletters are in — point it at the folder holding
`Template`, `Drafts` and `Published`.

The package is signed by Circuit Stitch, so Windows installs it without a
security warning.
